name: progressive-blur
title: Progressive Blur
description: A blur that gradually strengthens toward an edge, for fading out scrolling content or images.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the blurred band. Ignored when position is "both".

props.name: position
props.description: Edge the blur sits on; "both" covers the whole container.

props.name: blurLevels
props.description: Blur radius in pixels of each stacked layer, from the faintest to the strongest.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional content rendered inside the blur container (it is pointer-events-none).
